story: I'm Zach, an IT student at National University – MOA majoring in Mobile Web & App Development. I got into programming the way a lot of devs do: by wanting to build the games I was playing.

That curiosity turned into a Roblox game I design and script myself — it's still under development, and I'm still learning Luau as I build it — plus school projects across web and mobile. In my free time I do TikTok streaming and content creation. Building for real people taught me to test early, listen to feedback and keep shipping.

I want to get the most out of AI. Right now I'm learning two AI models side by side, figuring out how to bring out each one's full potential while researching different tech stacks. I'd love an OJT where I can put that to work on real projects.
